result.title: Gearbox transmission error, Staubli TX2-40 axes 2 and 3 (identifiable orders)
result.system: Staubli TX2-40 gearboxes on an experimental setup
result.quantity: theta_TE (rad), as published, at every published sample
result.baseline: B0: constant transmission error equal to the identification mean, per axis
result.model: as transmission-error (v1), but orders k are restricted to those completing at least 2 full periods over the shortest identification recording of the axis (k >= ceil(4 pi / span)); the 30 largest such orders up to 4000 are used
result.acceptance: per axis: validation RMSE(model) <= 0.5 x validation RMSE(B0) and validation RMSE(model) <= 1.5 x identification RMSE(model); X1 passes only if both axes pass (unchanged from v1)

split.identification: all files in identification/axis_2 and identification/axis_3
split.validation: all files in validation/axis_2 and validation/axis_3 (published split)
split.unused: identification/axis_1 (no validation recordings exist for axis 1)
